get.description:
The audit log, newest first. Filter by actor, resource, action and time; `from` and `to` are inclusive.
A date without a time means midnight: `to=2026-10-08` leaves out the events of that day.
Pass `meta.next_cursor` as `cursor` for the next page. An event holds identifiers only: `actor.name` and
`resource.name` are looked up now and are null when the account no longer exists.
Needs the `audit-event.view` permission.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description:
Compared with `from` only when there is one: on its own,
`after_or_equal:from` would refuse every `to`.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

next_cursor.description: The "cursor" that points to the next set of items.

prev_cursor.description: The "cursor" that points to the previous set of items.

get.description:
Sets the admin session cookie and the `XSRF-TOKEN-ADMIN` cookie.
The admin app sends the value of that cookie in the `X-XSRF-TOKEN`
header of every state-changing request. Call it once before logging in.
Only the admin origin may call it.

post.description:
Starts an administrator session. Call `GET /admin/auth/csrf-cookie` first
and send `X-XSRF-TOKEN`. A wrong password and an unknown email produce the same response.
Limited to 5 attempts per minute for one email from one address.
The session is complete only after the step in `meta.second_factor`: `challenge`
(send a code to `auth/two-factor/challenge`) or `enrollment` (set up two-factor first).

429.description: Too many requests. Retry after the seconds in `Retry-After`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit lets a request through again.

post.description: Ends the administrator session. The session ID stops working on the server.

Returns a new TOTP secret and its `otpauth://` URI for a QR code.
Two-factor is not on until `POST auth/two-factor/confirm` succeeds.
Calling this again replaces an unconfirmed secret.
Answers 409 when two-factor is already on.

The second step of a login: send `code` from the authenticator app, or `recovery_code`, which
works once. A code is refused when it was already used. Limited to 5 attempts per minute for one account.

204.description: The second factor is complete for this session.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry after the seconds in `Retry-After`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit lets a request through again.

post.description:
Turns two-factor on with a code from the authenticator app and completes the second factor
for this session. The recovery codes in the response are shown only once.

get.description: The administrator of the current session.

The branding of this installation, with the colors that fail WCAG AA and what the current administrator may do.
Needs the `branding.view` permission.

put.description:
Replaces the product name, the brand colors and the links. Send every field: null clears a color or a link.
A color is `#rrggbb`; a link is an `https` URL. A color that fails WCAG AA (4.5:1) against the default
surfaces is saved all the same and listed in `warnings`. Logos and the favicon have endpoints of their own.
Needs the `branding.update` permission.

delete.description:
Empties a slot: `logo-light`, `logo-dark` or `favicon`. The apps then show their built-in default.
Answers `200` for a slot that is already empty. Needs the `branding.update` permission.

post.description:
Replaces the image of a slot: `logo-light`, `logo-dark` or `favicon`. Send the file as `file` in a multipart
form. A logo is a PNG, JPEG or WebP file of at most 1024 KB and 2000 by 2000 pixels. The favicon is a square
PNG file of at most 256 KB and 512 by 512 pixels. SVG is not accepted. The type is read from the file itself;
its name is ignored. Needs the `branding.update` permission.

get.description:
The product name, logos, favicon, brand colors and links of this installation. Public and cacheable for five
minutes: send `If-None-Match` with the `ETag` of an earlier answer to get `304`. A logo, the favicon, a color
or a link that is null is not configured: keep your default.

200.description: The branding, or the defaults when nothing is configured.

429.description: Too many requests from this address: 300 a minute for this and the branding images together. Retry after the seconds in `Retry-After`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit lets a request through again.

get.description:
A logo or the favicon, as a PNG, JPEG or WebP file. Use the URLs of `GET /branding`: with their `v` the image
is immutable and may be cached for a year. Without `v`, or with the `v` of an earlier version, the current
image is sent and may be cached for five minutes. `404` when the slot is empty.

429.description: Too many requests from this address: 300 a minute for this and `GET /branding` together. Retry after the seconds in `Retry-After`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit lets a request through again.

ActorType.title: ActorType

AuditAction.title: AuditAction
